company.shortDescription: If you are looking to buy or sell used cars in Dubai, UAE, then Service My Car is the perfect platform for you.
company.description: ServiceMyCar is a UAE-based car service platform that provides vehicle maintenance and repair services. Customers can book services online, including oil changes, brake repairs, battery replacement, tire services, diagnostics, and general repairs. The platform also offers pickup and drop-off services and maintenance packages.
